mechanism: The University of Michigan expected-change-in-business-conditions series is a consumer diffusion measure of forward economic optimism. Rising optimism precedes stronger spending and risk-on equity conditions; falling optimism precedes retrenchment. The strategy holds SPY when optimism is elevated.
key_finding: Best search-phase rule uses chg_12m at L6 with OOS Sharpe 1.23 versus buy-and-hold 0.93.
caveats: Winner is search-selected on a single monthly sample and needs holdout validation.
Level thresholds are rolling-percentile based; regime pivots can drift across decades.
Lead estimates rest on a limited number of cycles in the sample.
narrative_summary: U. Michigan expected business conditions is tested as a procyclical sentiment overlay for SPY.
